metadata.title: Topographic contours - Homestead Valley Service Area (CSA 14), Marin County, California

source.lidar_quality_level: QL1 (>=8 pulses/m2, 10 cm RMSEz vertical accuracy spec)
tiles: USGS one meter x53y420 CA NoCal Wildfires B5b QL1 2018
USGS one meter x54y420 CA NoCal Wildfires B5b QL1 2018
source.archive: USGS The National Map / AWS s3://prd-tnm (public, no authentication)

verification.vertical_unit_evidence: regression against USGS 1/3 arc-second metric DEM: slope 1.00040, r=0.999976 (feet would give 3.28084)
verification.vertical_datum_evidence: mean bias vs USGS 3DEP NAVD88 reference = -0.004 m, RMSE 0.520 m; tidal-marsh minimum -0.011 m (an ellipsoidal datum would read ~-32 m)
verification.surface_type_evidence: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM exceeds this surface by a median of +2.80 m and +14.29 m at p90; local 1 m relief p99 is only 1.03 m
verification.horizontal_datum_caveat: Source DEM is NAD83 / UTM 10N (EPSG:26910). PROJ applied the EPSG-registered null transformation 'NAD83 to WGS 84 (1)'. The unmodelled NAD83(2011)-vs-WGS84(G2139) realisation drift in coastal California is approximately 1-1.5 m horizontally.

processing.working_crs: EPSG:26910 (NAD83 / UTM zone 10N) - the DEM's native CRS; elevation was never resampled, the AOI vector was reprojected instead
processing.contour_smoothing: Gaussian sigma=3.0 m applied before tracing; RMS vertical change 0.263 m = 4.3% of the contour interval
processing.simplification: Douglas-Peucker 1.0 m in projected metres; max measured displacement 1.000 m
